edits.before: Late Syndra is a one-button court-martial: flank, QE the carry, R the verdict. Spheres on the ground are sentences waiting.
edits.after: Two items keep QE into R lethal on him, but every minute of Stardust closes the gap — cash the lead before he ramps.

edits.before: Bully from minute one: Q poke is free, QE is terror, and most lanes concede CS by level 3. Bank splinters and spheres in equal measure.
edits.after: Bully from minute one: Q poke is free and he has no answer pre-stacks. Never sit low near Singularity — its center executes under a threshold.

edits.before: - Aurelion Sol Astral Flight: matchup-defining — His reposition and escape — he is a stationary battery while it is down. Check it before every step-up. - E Scatter the Weak is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Aurelion Sol Astral Flight: 22s at rank 1, 16s max — his reposition and escape; he is a stationary battery while it is down. - Singularity is 12s: step off its pull between casts. - Your E is 15s — the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - R answers fights, not waves.

edits.before: Spending E on chip-spacing and then watching the dash you bought it for arrive unanswered — the stun is the matchup, not the damage.
edits.after: Spending E on chip-spacing and then watching Astral Flight sail in or out unanswered — the stun is the matchup, not the damage.

edits.before: Good trade: Q the last-hit, W-slow the dodge attempt, QE the slowed line, Q again — a full bar of damage that started as routine poke. Bad trade: Spending E on chip-spacing and then watching the dash you bought it for arrive unanswered — the stun is the matchup, not the damage.
edits.after: Good trade: Q the last-hit, W-slow the dodge attempt, QE the slowed line, Q again — a full bar of damage that started as routine poke. Bad trade: Spending E on chip-spacing and then watching Astral Flight sail in or out unanswered — the stun is the matchup, not the damage.

edits.before: His reposition and escape — he is a stationary battery while it is down. Its cooldown is the green light — wait for it.
edits.after: Breath of Light is a channel and so is his flight — any QE stun cuts them dead, so every last-hit is a chip-and-cancel window.

edits.before: Q the last-hit, W-slow the dodge attempt, QE the slowed line, Q again — a full bar of damage that started as routine poke.
edits.after: A banked sphere makes the QE stun instant — the moment he starts an Astral Flight or steps up to stack Q, the line fires.

edits.before: Spending E on chip-spacing and then watching the dash you bought it for arrive unanswered — the stun is the matchup, not the damage.
edits.after: Overextended he cuts your retreat with a 1500-range Astral Flight and drags you into Singularity — hold Flash for the wall.
